title: Rejection bound for an empty property
statement: Let $n$ be positive, let $V$ be a PCPP system with Boolean inputs of length $n$, and let $P$ be a property of those inputs. Suppose $V$ is a PCPP for $P$ with positive rejection rate, and no input has property $P$. Then, for every input word and every proof word, the verifier's rejection probability is strictly greater than that rate.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean PCPP system with inputs of length $n$
A property of the Boolean input words
The system is a PCPP for the property with the stated rate
An input word and a proof word
